instruction: Draw the upper half of a horizontal elliptical arc centered at the origin, with major radius 18 mm and minor radius 10 mm. The arc should run from (18, 0) counterclockwise over the top to (-18, 0). Keep the standard construction helper geometry for the ellipse: the horizontal major-axis line from (18, 0) to (-18, 0), the vertical minor-axis line from (0, 10) to (0, -10), and the two construction focus points on the X axis. Do not leave any other sketch geometry. Save the completed model to /home/user/Unnamed.FCStd.
